snippet.title: Tomb Fetus - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The day is finally here! Select your favorite fella and jump into the arena! How soon, you might ask? Worry not, for this trailer will answer that very question... but not before a cool montage of what you'll see when you enter this wacky world.

---

Tomb Fetus is a party arena shooter! Choose a character and jump into a variety of arenas, from shipping warehouses and outdoor malls to outer space... and HELL! Hunt down weapons and powerups to take down your foes! On a round-to-round basis, you'll find yourself tackling many objectives, including frags, flags, and ancient artifacts!

Official Blog: https://pyspy.neocities.org/tf/
